description:
'Yebo' and 'Il', who were passionately in love when they were freshmen, were commonly called 'Weather Forecast' and were famous CCs in their department, but after they broke up, they each took a leave of absence. But, a few years later, they meet again at school?! “You guys don’t CC. It becomes like the weather forecast!” A rare CC that will not be forgotten even after taking a leave of absence. Will I be able to successfully complete the remainder of my college life?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=817987), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10307758)
